page.overview:
Who is Master Splinter?

Splinter (スプリンター Supurintā) is a mutant rat and is an important character in all incarnations of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles franchise, serving as the teacher/sensei, martial arts instructor, and adoptive father of the . In some incarnations, he is a mutated or reincarnated Hamato Yoshi; in others, he was Yoshi's pet rat who is sometimes known as Hamato Splinter.

Splinter's name and character is a reference to Daredevil character .
